## Chidester et al. (2018), thorianite experimental thermal EOS

Identifier: `thorianite_chidester_2018_bm3_linear_thermal`.

Availability: **Executable**.

Automatic selection for equilibrium calculations.


- **Record kind:** published
- **Origin of the parameterization:** experimental
- **Equation kind:** thermal
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Chidester; Pardo; Fischer; Thompson; Heinz; Prescher; Prakapenka; Campbell
    - **Year:** 2018
    - **Title:** High-pressure phase behavior and equations of state of ThO2 polymorphs
    - **Source:** American Mineralogist 103, 749–756
    - **DOI:** 10.2138/am-2018-6212
- **Reference temperature (K):** 300.0
- **Reported pressure coverage (GPa):** \[0, 28\]
- **Coverage provenance:** reported\_exactly
- **Reported temperature coverage (K):** \[300, 2135\]

| Component | Parameter | Value | Reported error | Fixed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Primary | V0 | 175.2134402119156 | 0.046495093880867706 | Yes |
| Primary | K0 | 204 | 2 | Not listed |
| Primary | K0\_prime | 4.0 | Not reported | Yes |
| Thermal | Tr | 300.0 | Not reported | Yes |
| Thermal | alpha\_KT | 0.0035 | 0.0003 | Not listed |

Values use the source model's parameter units. Primary `V0` uses
the conventional-cell volume declared above. Errors retain their reported
meaning; an absent error is unknown, and absence of covariance does not
establish statistical independence.

Only T=300 K rows with P&lt;15 GPa plus all high-T rows; 29 of 41 observations (ambient included). 12 anomalous room-temperature rows excluded, but preserved. Marginal envelopes are not a rectangular phase-stability guarantee; phase coexistence and kinetic inhibition occur. Published errors have unspecified confidence; fixed V0 measurement error is retained for thorianite. Published parameters are unchanged; diagnostic refits are not additional catalog EOSs. See docs/literature-reproductions/chidester-2018-tho2.md.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.
